Paul Emery's Guide to the 2015 NFL Draft

Paul Emery
Paul Emery’s Guide to the 2015 NFL Draft contains detailed descriptions of over 200 players, with a further 350 prospects mentioned in brief. The prospects are ranked by the author from in depth tape study (over 300 full games and countless cut up videos) and is honest opinion formed from years of experience and good old fashioned hard work.

In addition, the following features are included:
• quarterback - is the new wave already washed up?
• searching for the next late round/undrafted free agent 1,000+ yard rusher
• explaining one and two gap defensive line techniques
• All NFL Combine Team, the big winners from Indianapolis
• All Sleeper Team, the best underrated prospects

The Guide is written as much for the casual NFL fan as the hardened Draftnik and does away with more formal scouting reports, instead using a flowing writing style to describe each player. Rankings are not influenced by second/third hand judgements on character, they are purely formed from tape study with some influence from Combine data.

243 pages, Kindle Edition

First published March 28, 2015
